description: This file declares the 'Network' class, which functions as a plugin for network management within the WPEFramework. It inherits from PluginHost::IPlugin and PluginHost::JSONRPC, providing JSONRPC communication and network interface control functionalities. It includes methods for managing network interfaces, IP settings, connectivity, and events related to network status changes.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: A plugin class that manages network interfaces, settings, and status notifications within the WPEFramework environment.

methods.name: getInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves the list of network interfaces.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific network interface is enabled.

methods.name: setInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface.

methods.name: setDefaultInterface
methods.description: Sets a specific network interface as the default.

methods.name: doTrace
methods.description: Performs a trace operation on the network.

methods.name: doPing
methods.description: Pings a specified network target.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Sets IP configuration for an interface.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP configuration for an interface.

methods.name: getIPSettings2
methods.description: Retrieves additional IP configuration details.

methods.name: isConnectedToInternet
methods.description: Checks internet connectivity status.

methods.name: setConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Configures endpoints for connectivity testing.

methods.name: getInternetConnectionState
methods.description: Gets the current internet connection state.

methods.name: startConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Starts monitoring internet connectivity.

methods.name: getCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Gets the URI for captive portal detection.

methods.name: stopConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Stops internet connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: getPublicIP
methods.description: Retrieves the device’s public IP address.

methods.name: setStunEndpoint
methods.description: Sets the STUN server endpoint.

methods.name: getStbIp
methods.description: Retrieves the STB IP address.

methods.name: getSTBIPFamily
methods.description: Retrieves the IP family (IPv4/IPv6) of the STB.

methods.name: ReportonInterfaceStateChange
methods.description: Reports a change in network interface state.

methods.name: ReportonActiveInterfaceChange
methods.description: Reports a change in active network interface.

methods.name: ReportonIPAddressChange
methods.description: Reports a change in IP address.

methods.name: ReportonInternetStatusChange
methods.description: Reports changes in Internet status.

ctags.name: Network
ctags.pattern: /^        class Network : public PluginHost::IPlugin, public PluginHost::JSONRPC$/
